newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil Range suspends mining in Yukon.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Range suspends mining in Yukon.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp said on Wednesday it will temporarily suspend base metal and silver mining at its Faro Properties in the Yukon Territories.
Mining operations will stop on December 20 because of weak lead and zinc prices, the strengthening Canadian dollar and production output below budgeted levels, the company said in a release.
Anvil Range said it will continue to run its mill on previously stockpiled ore to produce concentrates at a level of about 50 percent of the intended output of 480,000 tonnes per year.

"Although this action may appear to be severe, Anvil Range believes that this course of action is prudent and in the longer run has fewer risks," chief executive Kurt Forgaard said in a letter to stakeholders of the company.
"It will also conserve our metal reserves for the future."

The company said it has experienced production problems in its mining and milling operations during the past two months. Lower production of zinc and lead concentrate coincided with falling metal prices, Anvil Range said.

"Although there is optimism that the recent production problems in the mine and mill may be behind us, current metal prices and the strength of the Canadian dollar over the next several months are continuing concerns," Forgaard said.
